background_matching: GSE5086 fitted log2 microarray intensity at age 50 is the expression proxy; age slope signs not used to choose background genes.
gene_mapping_source: HGNC nomenclature mirrored in gyorilab/indra indra/resources/hgnc_entries.tsv blob 67bc1e99d6ed12171a04daa4dd4e3a252b4bd8a4.
selection: Reused the fixed pilot panel: 50 HAGR up, 50 HAGR down, 50 GSE5086 age-50 expression-matched background genes. Panel existed before HCATA outcome extraction. HAGR directions are selection annotations, not HCATA truth. Prior pilot GI predictions had been inspected, so this is an exploratory follow-up, not a preregistered blinded model evaluation.
